rules: Each entry has one primary family and may reference additional families.
Learning types, tasks, data types, and entity kind are independent navigation axes.
Tags describe the configuration discussed here; architecture tags are common uses, not exhaustive capabilities.
Self-supervised and unsupervised categories can overlap; generative modeling is a task/family rather than a sixth learning paradigm.
Use full names for both meanings of LDA; alias search may return multiple entries.
Neural architectures need an objective and training method; an architecture tag does not select them.
Source references support technical explanations; proposed teaching controls are project choices.
